name: task_start
description: Open a multi-worker task room as host: splits a goal across worker sessions, sends the round-1 task card to every worker's talk inbox and reports who is live vs inactive. Returns the room name for task_assign/collect/close. Pass either workers (existing sessions) or worker_count (auto-spawned sessions owned by this room), not both.

goal.description: The work to split across workers (e.g. 'fix login retry').

workers.description: Worker session ids (1-8, from session_list; must exist, cannot include yourself). Either this or worker_count.

worker_count.description: Auto-spawn N worker sessions (1-8) owned by this room, e.g. 3. Fresh ids embed the room name; their databases are created by their own processes. Either this or workers.

max_rounds.description: Max rounds before forced close (default 5, clamped 1-10). Rework assignments consume rounds.

room.description: Optional room name (max 64 chars); auto-generated when omitted.
